messages.subject: Working Group tomorrow, 10/03
parts:
Hello all,

We will have a working group tomorrow, 10/03 from 11am-1pm in 360 Shield Library. For the first hour, Ryan Peek will give a tutorial on Intro to R: Vectors & Data Types. You can find materials similar to what Ryan will be covering here. If you'd like to follow along, please come with R and RStudio installed on your computer (instructions here). We hope to see you there!
